note: Permitted sources for the BI Portfolio's governance register. All of them are synthetic demo material written for AnalytIQ and approved for the public demo. No company policy document was supplied.

sources.title: Production dashboard ownership
sources.issuer: AnalytIQ demo content (synthetic, not a company policy)

1.title: Scope
1.text: This note applies to dashboards that the BI department has explicitly mapped to it and that sit in a production workspace.

2.title: Ownership handover
2.text: When accountability for a mapped dashboard changes, the current owner records the incoming accountable person in the governance record before the handover takes place.
